reason: My first worry is always whether it's actually tested, and a named lab with the report for my batch answers that. At $24.99 for the launch box I'd try one, since the money-back deal limits my risk.
objection: Still $25 for one month of magnesium when I can get cheaper bottles at the store. I'd only pay more here if the lab report really checks out.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price was gone and it was the full $29.99 for one box, I'd skip it and wait for the next coupon.
